The ultimate native scrolling screenshot experience for iOS.

Have you ever wanted to capture an entire conversation, a long list of tweaks, or an endless article, but hated manually stitching multiple images together? **Fullscreenshot** solves this natively.

Fullscreenshot deeply integrates into iOS so that when you trigger a standard screenshot (Volume Up + Power), it automatically scans the screen for a scrollable area and smoothly captures the entire length of the page—saving one massive, high-quality image directly to your Camera Roll.

### ✨ Seamless Native Integration
- No extra apps or weird gestures required. Just take a screenshot like you normally do (Volume Up + Power).

### 🧠 Smart Stitching Engine
- Bypasses "Estimated Row Heights" bugs by silently pre-measuring the entire scroll view before capturing, ensuring no cutoffs and no repeating sticky headers.

### 🚫 Native Screenshot Blocker
- Intelligent daemon hook that completely suppresses default Apple screenshots, keeping your Photos app uncluttered by duplicate short images (Supports iOS 16 `ScreenshotServicesService`).

### 🛡️ Memory Safe
- Automatically scales down image resolution on massive captures (over 12,000 pixels) to prevent Out-Of-Memory (OOM) crashes.

### 📳 Haptic Feedback & Custom Toasts
- Apple-style Heavy Impact & Success haptics with non-intrusive confirmation popups.

- **Enable/Disable Tweak**: Master killswitch.
- **Save Native Screenshot**: Toggle keeping or discarding short iOS screenshot.
- **Haptic Feedback**: Toggle vibration feedback.
- **Max Screenshot Height**: Slider (up to 30,000px) limiting max scrolling height.

- **v1.1**: Bug fixes, Added Finger gesture.
- **v1.0**: Initial release.
